flash_sale_item_stock_chk.value: "flash_sale_item"."sale_price_idr" >= 0 and "flash_sale_item"."sold_count" >= 0 and ("flash_sale_item"."stock_cap" is null or ("flash_sale_item"."stock_cap" >= 1 and "flash_sale_item"."sold_count" <= "flash_sale_item"."stock_cap"))

shipping_partner_budget_chk.name: shipping_partner_budget_chk
shipping_partner_budget_chk.value: "shipping_partner_budget"."key" = 'partner:mengantar' and "shipping_partner_budget"."tokens" between 0 and 60 and "shipping_partner_budget"."registrations" between 0 and 1000

shipping_account_sealed_chk.name: shipping_account_sealed_chk
shipping_account_sealed_chk.value: ("store_shipping_account"."sealed_key" is null and "store_shipping_account"."key_id" is null and "store_shipping_account"."sealed_at" is null) or ("store_shipping_account"."sealed_key" is not null and "store_shipping_account"."key_id" is not null and "store_shipping_account"."sealed_at" is not null and "store_shipping_account"."kind" = 'partner_managed')

shipping_account_active_chk.name: shipping_account_active_chk
shipping_account_active_chk.value: "store_shipping_account"."status" <> 'active' or "store_shipping_account"."kind" = 'platform_master' or ("store_shipping_account"."sealed_key" is not null and "store_shipping_account"."mengantar_seller_id" is not null)

affiliate_attribution_status_chk.name: affiliate_attribution_status_chk
affiliate_attribution_status_chk.value: "affiliate_attribution"."status" in ('pending', 'credited', 'paid_out', 'void') and ("affiliate_attribution"."status" <> 'void' or "affiliate_attribution"."void_reason" is not null) and ("affiliate_attribution"."status" in ('pending', 'void') or "affiliate_attribution"."eligible_at" is not null)

affiliate_catalog_active_chk.name: affiliate_catalog_active_chk
affiliate_catalog_active_chk.value: not "affiliate_catalog"."active" or ("affiliate_catalog"."rate_bps" is not null and "affiliate_catalog"."price_from_idr" is not null)
